instruction_summary: Corrective study 003: apply exactly the five audit-conformance corrections (PS-PROV-1..5) to parent studies 001 and 002, relabel mislabeled vintages / source-or-remove unsourced numbers (no verdict or grid-cell changes, no score), record the China-BOF preview correction, and log every old -> new change.

deviations: No verdict word or evidence-grid cell changed; no numeric/pooled score produced (inherited GO-WITH-SCOPE rule) -- by design.
Item 6 recorded in preview_corrections.md and flagged forward; the spec itself was NOT edited (orchestrator's file).

Item 5 resolved to a REMOVAL (not a citation) because the staged texts contained no citable Foxconn/single-plant employment figure -- the instruction's explicit fallback.

Item 1 also relabeled two further reader-facing 001 surfaces that carried the mislabel (results/scorecard.csv, results/_blockB_keyresults.json). 001's generator scripts (analyze.py, scorecard.py) keep the internal 'va_share_1984' key name: not a result surface, not named in item 1, not re-run -- left untouched to avoid scope creep (unlike item 4, where build_signatures.py was explicitly named as the cause and its _2005 keys were fixed).
